# Key Terms
Structural Cognition: A framework where relationships precede entities, coupling drives emergence, and observation itself is a perturbation.
P=P=P*: The same root structure P projects into different appearances P* across observation scales — surfaces differ, the underlying structure is unified.
Four Axioms: (1) Relation > Entity, (2) P=P=P* Isomorphic Projection, (3) Observation-Coupling Boundary, (4) Steady-State Persistence.
Coupling Loop: Multi-platform monitoring + personality-driven response + closed feedback loop.
